triage.reason: allowed_ is meant to start false and is set true only when the asset is found in the sealed list; the default is the fail-closed value.

triage.description: CategoryBudgetEnforcer.beforeHook(bytes,bytes,ModeCode,bytes,bytes32,address,address).found_ (src/enforcers/CategoryBudgetEnforcer.sol#93) is a local variable never initialized
triage.reason: found_ starts false and is set only when the category is in the sealed list; if it stays false the hook reverts with CategoryBudgetExceeded (fail closed).

triage.description: CategoryBudgetEnforcer.beforeHook(bytes,bytes,ModeCode,bytes,bytes32,address,address).cap_ (src/enforcers/CategoryBudgetEnforcer.sol#92) is a local variable never initialized
triage.reason: cap_ is read only after found_ is true, and it is assigned in the same branch that sets found_.
Only the local agent id is needed to decide whether the beneficiary is an agent; status and DID are deliberately ignored here (VerifiedPayeeEnforcer governs who may be paid).
Payee verification needs only the active flag; the category is consumed by the budget and co-sign enforcers.
Both the recovered signer and the RecoverError are checked; the ignored third value is only the error argument used for revert data.
Only call type and exec type decide single/default mode; mode selector and payload are not interpreted by the framework's DeleGatorCore for single default executions.
The pause check needs agent id and status only; the owner DID is checked by AgentLineageEnforcer.
The forbidden-target rule concerns only the call target; value and calldata are governed by ValueLte and AllowedMethods and the payment enforcers.
Same pattern as YinglongEnforcer._requireSingleDefault: only call type and exec type are relevant.
